title: Closing the gap: young men’s loneliness and support in the UK
discussion_signal: Movember’s discussion connects frequent loneliness among young men with trusted relationships, belonging, willingness to seek emotional support, and community-led alternatives to traditional health services.
linked_research_question: How do family support, friendships, mental health, bullying, and work or education status structure persistent disconnection among boys and young men?
limits: The post is advocacy and fundraising communication
It does not provide the full survey or evaluation design
Community funding intentions do not establish long-run mental-health outcomes
